It needs no unique, only weapons on the ground and a Necromancer shell to keep them alive.

builds.summary: Self-cast Arc on the Elementalist shell. Arc clears packs without aiming, the exposure and shock package turns lightning into a real single-target tool, and the gear is the same spell sceptre and shield the totem build uses. No required unique.

builds.name: Arc Totem Hierophant
builds.summary: The Tendrils totem is the default link: Lightning Tendrils of Eccentricity channels a semicircle in front of the totem, and every fifth pulse is stronger (a much larger area and an automatic critical strike), so the same six-link clears packs and kills bosses from two Spell Totems. The measured damage is per totem. Arc drops into the four-link helmet when an open layout wants a chain more than a frontal pulse. The Hierophant totem package pays for both totems, and no unique is required: a rare six-link, a spell sceptre and capped resistances are the core of the bill. For spread packs, swap Concentrated Effect for Increased Area of Effect or use the Arc helmet.

builds.name: Boneshatter Juggernaut
builds.summary: League-start melee build. Boneshatter trades a little life for stacks, so the gear is armour and resistances, the axe is a rare with attack speed, and the ascendancy makes the trauma survivable. Herald of Purity and Vulnerability turn the axe into damage, and no unique is required, which is what a strength build needs on day one of a solo league.
